PASSAGE I

THE WETLANDS · FIRST LIGHT

The water wakes.
A wing unfolds.

Reeds bow beneath a white shadow. The crane lifts from the shallows, carrying a little of the pond into the open sky.

Below, every ripple
remembers the departure.

水
PASSAGE II

THE MOUNTAINS · DRIFTING MIST

Between two clouds,
the world grows quiet.

Blue ridges rise like brushstrokes. A vermilion gate slips into the valley. The crane follows a path only the wind can see.

Nothing to hold.
Only the air beneath a wing.

風
PASSAGE III

THE PINE GROVE · GOLDEN HOUR

Even the sky
has a way home.

Past the pines, a waterfall loosens into silver. The wings open one last time, and the distance becomes a familiar kind of stillness.

Some journeys lead outward.
Some bring us back to ourselves.

THE SCROLL ENDS. THE SKY GOES ON.

Leave a little room
for wonder.

There is no hurry to arrive.
